_comment: Known-answer test for the preimage_knowledge circuit's Phase 2B integration.
Scope: this file pins the PROOF BYTE DIGEST for a fixed (witness, public-inputs) pair
under the placeholder AIR. Once Step 2.b lands the real Rescue-Prime AIR, this file
must be re-frozen with the new bytes. Refresh procedure:
Determinism contract: Two prove() calls with the same witness, the same
ProofOptions (STARK_OPTIONS), and the same prover_seed MUST produce byte-identical
proof bytes. If proof_sha256 differs across runs, the Winterfell PRNG is leaking
entropy and the canary test (tests/e2e/canary.sh) will also fail.
The placeholder AIR proves: 'I know commitment[0..4] such that they equal
public_inputs.commitment[0..4]'. Soundness-meaningless on its own; the file exists
to lock in the integration-level byte stability so any change to ProofOptions, hash
choice, or PRNG seeding is detected at CI time.
